The Bulls defeated the Cavaliers, 122-108 tonight in Chicago. Jordan Hawkins finished with a team-high 19 points along with 4 three pointers and 2 assists for the Bulls, while Buddy Hield tallied 17 points, 5 rebounds and 4 three pointers in the game. Donovan Mitchell recorded 28 points, 5 assists and 3 rebounds. The Bulls improve their record to 5-12 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 9-9 for the season.
